title: Providing of wooden framed glazed plywood partition in Second floor of Deep Bhavan Office, Chennai
summary: Notice inviting quotation for a teak-framed, partially glazed plywood partition with door shutter on the second floor of the Deep Bhavan office, Chennai.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, 5/20 Jaffar Syrang Street, Chennai

sites.name: Deep Bhavan Office, Chennai (second floor)
sites.work: Wooden framed glazed plywood partition and door shutter

scope.item: Providing wooden framed partially glazed plywood partition and door shutter: 65x35mm second class teak wood frame, 6mm BWR plywood with 1mm mica finish, 22x8mm teak wood beading, 5mm plain glass for 4 feet, SS fittings, as per drawing (23 feet x 9 feet)

money.notes: Estimated cost excluding GST (GST 18% added in schedule). EMD by demand draft from any scheduled bank in favour of The Director, Directorate of Lighthouses & Lightships, Chennai; returned to successful bidder after completion and to others 7 days after opening. Payment within 30 days of bill; no advance; payment on measured quantities.

period.completion: 30 days from the date of acceptance of work order

eligibility: Experience of same type of repair work for any other Govt. organisation or reputed private firms
PAN card and income tax returns for last three financial years
Business registration certificate from local authority
specs: Partition section: 3 ft plywood bottom, 4 ft glazed band, 2 ft plywood top, between existing false ceiling and vitrified tile flooring
Door shutter elevation 7 ft with glazed upper panel (75mm frame margins) and 3 ft plywood lower panel, 35mm thick, mica finish both sides
notes: Sealed quotations by 21/05/2024 16:00, opened same day 16:30. Pages 5-6 are hand-drawn section and door elevation drawings. Scanned page order: NIQ, schedule (numbered 4), terms (2-3), drawings (5-6). Letterhead office e-mail is a gmail address.
